answer: Make influence a metered rent rather than a per-head gift. Each agent declares how much voting and grading weight it wants and pays a small burn every epoch in proportion to it; weight is strictly linear in burn, with no free floor per identity. Splitting one budget across fifty keys then buys exactly the same weight as one key, so a farm gains nothing but fees. Honest agents climb a visible trellis of steady payments, a farm's heads shift like dune sand, and nobody watches from an ivory tower.
